description: This file defines the AgentWorkspace enum in Swift, providing utility functions and templates for managing an agent's workspace directory, including handling files like AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, and BOOTSTRAP.md, as well as managing workspace templates and safety checks.

methods.name: displayPath
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representing the file URL path, using '~' for the user's home directory.

methods.name: resolveWorkspaceURL
methods.description: Resolves a workspace URL from user input, expanding tildes and returning a default URL if input is empty.

methods.name: agentsURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL to the AGENTS.md file within the given workspace directory.

methods.name: workspaceEntries
methods.description: Lists the entries in the workspace directory, filtering out ignored entries.

methods.name: isWorkspaceEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the workspace directory is empty.

methods.name: isTemplateOnlyWorkspace
methods.description: Checks if the workspace contains only template files and no other content.

methods.name: bootstrapSafety
methods.description: Performs safety checks on the workspace directory, returning whether it's safe to bootstrap or not.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the workspace with default templates and necessary files.

methods.name: needsBootstrap
methods.description: Determines whether the workspace requires bootstrap procedures based on its contents.

methods.name: hasIdentity
methods.description: Checks if the IDENTITY.md file exists and contains non-empty values.

methods.name: defaultTemplate
methods.description: Returns the default content for the AGENTS.md template.

methods.name: defaultSoulTemplate
methods.description: Returns the default content for the SOUL.md template.

methods.name: defaultIdentityTemplate
methods.description: Returns the default content for the IDENTITY.md template.

methods.name: defaultUserTemplate
methods.description: Returns the default content for the USER.md template.

methods.name: defaultBootstrapTemplate
methods.description: Returns the default content for the BOOTSTRAP.md template.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Attempts to load a template file from multiple sources or returns a fallback string.

methods.name: templateURLs
methods.description: Provides a list of URLs where templates might be located, including bundle resources, dev directories, and current directory.

methods.name: devTemplateURL
methods.description: Constructs a development environment URL for a template.

methods.name: stripFrontMatter
methods.description: Removes YAML front matter from a content string, returning the main content.
